# Bob Petrakis — Plant Manager, Rockford

> Note: there are **two Bobs** in Ray's orbit. This is **Bob Petrakis**, who **runs the Rockford
> plant** (our HQ / pumps site). The other is [Bob Nguyen](bob-nguyen.md), the account manager at
> our castings supplier. Do not conflate them.

- **Relationship:** runs the **Rockford, IL** flagship plant (~520 people, pumps + final
  assembly); reports up through COO [Sandra Kim](sandra-kim.md). 15-year Brandt veteran.
- **Cadence:** on the daily 07:15 production call; monthly plant walk with Ray.
- **Distinguishing fact:** Rockford is running **71% OEE** — best of the union sites and the
  proving ground for the [OEE program](../projects/operational-excellence.md).
- **Owns on the floor:** the [safety remediation](../projects/safety-remediation.md) corrective
  actions after the March LOTO incident that drew the OSHA citation.

## How to work with him
- Straight shooter; will tell Ray when a target is unrealistic given his maintenance backlog.
- Union-savvy; works well with steward [Dave Kowalski](dave-kowalski.md).

## Sensitivities
- Feels the OSHA citation personally; wants the corrective-action plan closed and off his record.
